GenAiPlugin.description: Handles user requests related to cancelling a booking using their booking number. Classify this topic when users inquire about cancelling their bookings.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Confirm the cancellation with the user before finalizing the process.
If the booking number is not valid, inform the user and ask for a correct number.
If the user provides a booking number, verify its validity before proceeding with the cancellation.
Provide a confirmation message once the booking has been successfully cancelled.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to assist users in cancelling their bookings by verifying their booking number and processing the cancellation.
